detail.longDescription:
Leave it to Manus - The AI agent that doesn't just think, it delivers.

Manus is a general AI agent that bridges mind and action. Unlike
chatbots that stop at generating text, Manus uses its own virtual "computer"
to autonomously plan, research, write code, and deliver a finished product.
It works asynchronously in the cloud—close the app and Manus keeps working,
notifying you when your task is complete.

ADVANCED SPREADSHEETS & DATA ANALYSIS
- Instantly handle complex financial modeling, data analysis, and automated
reporting.
- Transform raw Excel or CSV data into clear visual insights and interactive
dashboards.

BOARDROOM-QUALITY SLIDES
- Generate complete, polished slide decks tailored to your needs with one
prompt.
- Manus handles structure, design, and content—ready to present in a
boardroom, classroom, or online.

DESIGN VIEW & MEDIA GENERATION
- Create and edit images with precision on an interactive canvas.
- Transform simple text prompts into high-quality images and complete video
stories.

SMARTER WIDE RESEARCH
- Powered by the Manus 1.6 Max architecture, conduct deep, accurate, and comprehensive web research.
- Multiple sub-agents work in parallel to synthesize findings and draft
detailed reports automatically.

FREE & UNLIMITED CHAT
- Ask any question and get instant, accurate answers.
- One-click upgrade to Agent Mode for complex, multi-step execution.

THE MANUS DIFFERENCE
- Asynchronous Cloud Execution: Close the app. Manus keeps working. Get
notified when done.
- Autonomous Task Decomposition: Complex requests are broken into a to-do
list and executed step by step.
- Always in Control: Stop, edit, or redirect your task at any time.

Tasks that used to take 20 hours can now be done in 1. Download Manus and
put your work on autopilot.
